title: Skills combine with enchantments
changes: Enchantments now power up your other skills: with Fire Arrows lit, a Volley is a volley of fire arrows that sets every target ablaze.
Works for every enchantment (Fire Arrows, Holy Blade, Poison Blade, Blade Flurry) and every skill cast while it lasts: arrows, blasts, dashes, traps and sentries.
Enchanted arrows and skill blasts now glow and trail in the enchantment's colour.
